summary: Iteration 82: Voice Capabilities Testing - All features PASSED. Backend TTS/STT endpoints working correctly. Frontend voice controls (toggle, mic button) present and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: TTS endpoint correctly uses OpenAI TTS via Emergent with nova (female) and onyx (male) voices
STT endpoint correctly uses Whisper via Emergent for transcription
VoiceSelector component properly cycles through null → 'female' → 'male' → null states
ChatInputArea includes mic button with MediaRecorder API for voice input
TTS playback integrated into sendMessage flow - plays audio when voiceMode is set
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 82 verified voice capabilities. Backend: POST /api/chat/tts returns valid MP3 base64 audio for both nova (female) and onyx (male) voices, returns 400 for empty text. POST /api/chat/stt accepts audio file uploads. Frontend: Voice toggle button (data-testid='voice-toggle') cycles Off → Female (F label) → Male (M label) → Off. Mic button (data-testid='chat-mic-btn') present for voice input. Image upload button still works alongside mic. No regressions in chat functionality.

female_voice_nova.details: POST /api/chat/tts with voice='nova' returns valid MP3 base64 audio

male_voice_onyx.details: POST /api/chat/tts with voice='onyx' returns valid MP3 base64 audio

default_voice.details: Uses nova (female) as default voice when not specified

long_text_handling.details: Handles long text by truncating to 4096 chars

missing_file_validation.details: Returns 422 when no audio file provided

voice_toggle_button.details: Voice toggle button visible in chat header with data-testid='voice-toggle'

voice_toggle_cycling.details: Cycles correctly: Off (VolumeX icon) → Female ('F' label, teal) → Male ('M' label, teal) → Off

mic_button.details: Mic button visible in input area with data-testid='chat-mic-btn'

image_upload_coexistence.details: Image upload button (data-testid='chat-image-upload') still works alongside mic button

chat_input.details: Chat input (data-testid='chat-input') and send button (data-testid='chat-send') present
